name: add-to-agent-context
description: Copies the active file's full path with the selected line range, or adds it straight into a coding agent's context.

commands.title: Open Last Agent Chat in Sidebar
Add Explorer Selection to Last Agent

addToAgentContext.selectionPopup.description: Show a popup with a button for each available agent and a "Copy to clipboard" button after selecting text with the mouse, and when hovering over selected text
addToAgentContext.selectionPopup.markdownDescription: Show a popup next to the cursor after selecting text with the mouse (except when double-clicking a word), and when hovering over selected text. It has an **Add to _agent_** button for each available agent and a **Copy to clipboard** button.

addToAgentContext.agents.description: Agents that selections can be sent to, keyed by agent id
addToAgentContext.agents.markdownDescription: Agents that selections can be sent to, keyed by a stable agent id. The id is used to remember the last agent, and can be passed as `args` to commands that target the last agent to pick one directly. Your entries are merged with the defaults: add a new key to add an agent, set only the fields you want to change on an existing one, or set it to `null` to remove it. Each entry needs a `command`. An agent whose extension is missing, or whose command is no longer registered, is shown as unavailable.

label.description: Name shown in the destination picker; defaults to the agent id

extensionId.description: Publisher-qualified extension id, checked to tell 'not installed' from 'command renamed'

command.description: Command that adds the current editor selection to the agent's context
command.markdownDescription: Command that adds the current editor selection to the agent's context. Called with no arguments, so it has to read the selection from the active editor itself. Called once per selected line range, with only that range selected in the editor at the time, so agent commands that only read the primary selection still receive every range. With nothing selected, it's called once with the editor's selection unchanged.

fileCommand.description: Command that adds a file or folder to the agent's context, called with its URI
fileCommand.markdownDescription: Command that adds a file or folder to the agent's context. Called once per item selected in the explorer, with that item's URI as the only argument. Agents without it are not offered by `addToAgentContext.sendExplorerSelectionToAgent`.

openChatInSidebarCommand.description: Command that opens the agent's chat in the sidebar and focuses it
openChatInSidebarCommand.markdownDescription: Command that opens the agent's chat in the sidebar and focuses it. Used by `addToAgentContext.openLastChatInSidebar` and `addToAgentContext.openChatInSidebar`; agents without it can't be opened.

pasteExplorerPathsDirectly.description: Experimental: paste the paths of files and folders selected in the explorer into the agent's chat instead of calling fileCommand
pasteExplorerPathsDirectly.markdownDescription: **Experimental.** Lets `addToAgentContext.sendExplorerSelectionToLastAgent` and `addToAgentContext.sendExplorerSelectionToAgent` send to the agent even without a `fileCommand`, as long as it has an `openChatInSidebarCommand`. Instead of calling `fileCommand`, it copies the absolute paths of the selected files and folders to the clipboard, each prefixed with `@` and separated by spaces, opens the agent's chat with `openChatInSidebarCommand` and pastes them into the chat input. The paths stay on the clipboard, so if the paste doesn't land, paste them into the chat yourself.
